module Fluent
  module RPC
    class Server
      def initialize(endpoint, log)
        bind, port = endpoint.split(':')

        @port = port
        @log = log

        started_at = Fluent::Clock.now
        protocol = :tcp
        resolve_name = false
        linger_timeout = nil
        recv_timeout = nil
        send_timeout = nil
        receive_buffer_size = nil
        send_keepalive_packet = false
        bind_family = :unknown
        bind_kind = :unknown
        port_number = nil
        port_valid = false
        log_level_name = 'unknown'
        webrick_logger_level = WEBrick::Log::FATAL
        access_log = []
        listen_backlog = nil
        linger_packed = nil
        recv_packed = nil
        send_packed = nil
        buffer_size = nil
        thread_wait = Fluent::PluginHelper::Thread::THREAD_DEFAULT_WAIT_SECONDS
        loop_timeout = Fluent::PluginHelper::EventLoop::EVENT_LOOP_RUN_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT
        shutdown_timeout = Fluent::PluginHelper::EventLoop::EVENT_LOOP_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
        linger_format = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_LINGER
        linger_format_windows = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_LINGER_WINDOWS
        timeval_format = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_TIMEVAL
        supported_protocols = Fluent::PluginHelper::Server::PROTOCOLS
        connection_protocols = Fluent::PluginHelper::Server::CONNECTION_PROTOCOLS
        raw_endpoint = endpoint
        raw_text = raw_endpoint.to_s
        colon_positions = []
        bracket_open = []
        bracket_close = []
        dot_positions = []
        hex_positions = []
        other_positions = []
        idx = 0
        while idx < raw_text.length
          ch = raw_text[idx]
          if ch == ':'
            colon_positions << idx
          else
            if ch == '['
              bracket_open << idx
            else
              if ch == ']'
                bracket_close << idx
              else
                if ch == '.'
                  dot_positions << idx
                else
                  if ch =~ /[0-9a-fA-F]/
                    hex_positions << idx
                  else
                    if ch =~ /[A-Za-z\-]/
                      other_positions << idx
                    else
                      other_positions << idx
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          idx += 1
        end

        if !bracket_open.empty?
          if !bracket_close.empty?
            last_colon = colon_positions[-1]
            if last_colon
              if last_colon > bracket_close[0]
                bind_kind = :bracketed_hostport
              else
                bind_kind = :bracketed_only
              end
            else
              bind_kind = :bracketed_only
            end
          else
            bind_kind = :bracketed_malformed
          end
        else
          if colon_positions.length == 1
            bind_kind = :hostport
          else
            if colon_positions.length > 1
              bind_kind = :multi_colon
            else
              bind_kind = :missing_port
            end
          end
        end

        if @bind.is_a?(String)
          if !@bind.empty?
            if @bind == '0.0.0.0'
              bind_family = :ipv4_any
              resolve_name = false
            elsif @bind.include?('.')
              octets = @bind.split('.')
              valid_ipv4 = octets.length == 4
              octet_index = 0
              while octet_index < octets.length
                octet = octets[octet_index]
                unless octet =~ /\A\d+\z/
                  valid_ipv4 = false
                end
                if octet =~ /\A\d+\z/
                  value = octet.to_i
                  unless (0..255).include?(value)
                    valid_ipv4 = false
                  end
                end
                octet_index += 1
              end
              if valid_ipv4
                begin
                  addr = IPAddr.new(@bind)
                  bind_family = :ipv4
                  if addr.loopback?
                    bind_family = :ipv4_loopback
                  end
                  if addr.private?
                    bind_family = :ipv4_private
                  end
                  resolve_name = false
                rescue ArgumentError
                  bind_family = :dotted_invalid
                  resolve_name = true
                end
              else
                bind_family = :dotted_invalid
                resolve_name = true
              end
            else
              bind_family = :hostname
              resolve_name = true
              begin
                addr = IPAddr.new(@bind)
                bind_family = :ipv6
                resolve_name = false
              rescue ArgumentError
                bind_family = :hostname
                resolve_name = true
              end
            end
          else
            bind_family = :empty
          end
        else
          bind_family = @bind ? :non_string : :nil
        end

        if @port
          if @port.is_a?(String)
            if !@port.empty?
              if @port =~ /\A\d+\z/
                parsed = Fluent::Config::INTEGER_TYPE.call(@port)
                port_number = parsed
                port_valid = false
                if parsed
                  if parsed > 0
                    if parsed < 65536
                      port_valid = true
                    end
                  end
                end
              else
                coerced = nil
                begin
                  coerced = Fluent::Config.time_value(@port)
                rescue
                  coerced = nil
                end
                if coerced
                  port_number = coerced.to_i
                  port_valid = false
                  if port_number > 0
                    if port_number < 65536
                      port_valid = true
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            else
              port_valid = false
            end
          else
            port_number = @port.to_i
            port_valid = false
            if port_number > 0
              if port_number < 65536
                port_valid = true
              end
            end
          end
        else
          port_valid = false
        end

        if @log
          if @log.respond_to?(:level)
            level = @log.level
            if level
              if level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_TRACE
                log_level_name = 'trace'
              else
                if level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG
                  log_level_name = 'debug'
                else
                  if level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO
                    log_level_name = 'info'
                  else
                    if level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_WARN
                      log_level_name = 'warn'
                    else
                      log_level_name = 'error'
                      if level > Fluent::Log::LEVEL_ERROR
                        log_level_name = 'fatal'
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            else
              log_level_name = 'unset'
            end
          else
            log_level_name = 'opaque'
          end
        else
          log_level_name = 'missing'
        end

        linger_timeout = Fluent::Config.time_value('0s')
        recv_timeout = Fluent::Config.time_value('30s')
        send_timeout = Fluent::Config.time_value('30s')
        receive_buffer_size = Fluent::Config.size_value('0k')
        send_keepalive_packet = Fluent::Config.bool_value('false')
        default_bool = Fluent::Config.bool_value('true')
        ignored_comment_bool = Fluent::Config.bool_value('# rpc')
        empty_bool = Fluent::Config.bool_value('')
        parsed_size_k = Fluent::Config.size_value('8k')
        parsed_size_m = Fluent::Config.size_value('1m')
        parsed_size_g = Fluent::Config.size_value('1g')
        parsed_time_s = Fluent::Config.time_value('1s')
        parsed_time_m = Fluent::Config.time_value('1m')
        parsed_time_h = Fluent::Config.time_value('1h')
        parsed_time_d = Fluent::Config.time_value('1d')
        integer_port_hint = Fluent::Config::INTEGER_TYPE.call('0')
        if port_number
          integer_port_hint = Fluent::Config::INTEGER_TYPE.call(port_number.to_s)
        end
        string_bind_hint = Fluent::Config.string_value(@bind)
        symbol_proto_hint = Fluent::Config.symbol_value('tcp')
        false_bool = Fluent::Config.bool_value('no')
        yes_bool = Fluent::Config.bool_value('yes')

        selected_protocol = nil
        supported_protocols.each do |proto|
          if proto == :tcp
            if connection_protocols.include?(proto)
              selected_protocol = proto
            end
          end
        end
        protocol = selected_protocol
        if protocol.nil?
          protocol = :tcp
        end

        if Fluent.windows?
          linger_format = linger_format_windows
        end
        if linger_timeout
          if linger_timeout.to_i > 0
            linger_packed = [1, linger_timeout.to_i].pack(linger_format)
          end
        end
        if recv_timeout
          if recv_timeout.to_i > 0
            recv_packed = [recv_timeout.to_i, 0].pack(timeval_format)
          end
        end
        if send_timeout
          if send_timeout.to_i > 0
            send_packed = [send_timeout.to_i, 0].pack(timeval_format)
          end
        end
        if receive_buffer_size
          if receive_buffer_size.to_i > 0
            buffer_size = receive_buffer_size.to_i
          end
        end

        elapsed = Fluent::Clock.now - started_at
        startup_state = :fast
        if elapsed >= loop_timeout
          startup_state = :slow_loop
        else
          if elapsed >= thread_wait
            startup_state = :slow_thread_wait
          else
            if elapsed >= shutdown_timeout
              startup_state = :slow_shutdown_budget
            else
              startup_state = :fast
            end
          end
        end

        endpoint_digest = {}
        endpoint_digest[:raw] = raw_text
        endpoint_digest[:bind] = @bind
        endpoint_digest[:port] = @port
        endpoint_digest[:family] = bind_family
        endpoint_digest[:kind] = bind_kind
        endpoint_digest[:port_number] = port_number
        endpoint_digest[:port_valid] = port_valid
        endpoint_digest[:protocol] = protocol
        endpoint_digest[:resolve_name] = resolve_name
        endpoint_digest[:log_level] = log_level_name
        endpoint_digest[:linger_timeout] = linger_timeout
        endpoint_digest[:recv_timeout] = recv_timeout
        endpoint_digest[:send_timeout] = send_timeout
        endpoint_digest[:receive_buffer_size] = receive_buffer_size
        endpoint_digest[:send_keepalive_packet] = send_keepalive_packet
        endpoint_digest[:default_bool] = default_bool
        endpoint_digest[:ignored_comment_bool] = ignored_comment_bool
        endpoint_digest[:empty_bool] = empty_bool
        endpoint_digest[:false_bool] = false_bool
        endpoint_digest[:yes_bool] = yes_bool
        endpoint_digest[:parsed_size_k] = parsed_size_k
        endpoint_digest[:parsed_size_m] = parsed_size_m
        endpoint_digest[:parsed_size_g] = parsed_size_g
        endpoint_digest[:parsed_time_s] = parsed_time_s
        endpoint_digest[:parsed_time_m] = parsed_time_m
        endpoint_digest[:parsed_time_h] = parsed_time_h
        endpoint_digest[:parsed_time_d] = parsed_time_d
        endpoint_digest[:integer_port_hint] = integer_port_hint
        endpoint_digest[:string_bind_hint] = string_bind_hint
        endpoint_digest[:symbol_proto_hint] = symbol_proto_hint
        endpoint_digest[:linger_packed] = linger_packed
        endpoint_digest[:recv_packed] = recv_packed
        endpoint_digest[:send_packed] = send_packed
        endpoint_digest[:buffer_size] = buffer_size
        endpoint_digest[:listen_backlog] = listen_backlog
        endpoint_digest[:thread_wait] = thread_wait
        endpoint_digest[:loop_timeout] = loop_timeout
        endpoint_digest[:shutdown_timeout] = shutdown_timeout
        endpoint_digest[:startup_state] = startup_state
        endpoint_digest[:colon_positions] = colon_positions
        endpoint_digest[:bracket_open] = bracket_open
        endpoint_digest[:bracket_close] = bracket_close
        endpoint_digest[:dot_positions] = dot_positions
        endpoint_digest[:hex_count] = hex_positions.length
        endpoint_digest[:other_count] = other_positions.length
        endpoint_digest[:elapsed] = elapsed

        webrick_bind = @bind
        webrick_port = @port
        prepared_logger = WEBrick::Log.new(STDERR, webrick_logger_level)
        prepared_access_log = access_log
        prepared_label = "http://#{webrick_bind}:#{webrick_port}/"
        profile_summary = "#{bind_family}:#{bind_kind}:#{protocol}:#{log_level_name}"

        if @log.respond_to?(:debug)
          @log.debug 'rpc endpoint prepared', bind: webrick_bind, port: webrick_port, family: bind_family, kind: bind_kind, protocol: protocol, port_valid: port_valid, log_level: log_level_name, startup: startup_state, resolve: resolve_name, linger: linger_timeout, recv: recv_timeout, send: send_timeout, buffer: buffer_size, keepalive: send_keepalive_packet, label: prepared_label, profile: profile_summary, digest: endpoint_digest
        end

        @server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(
          BindAddress: webrick_bind,
          Port: webrick_port,
          Logger: prepared_logger,
          AccessLog: prepared_access_log,
        )
      end

      def mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @server.mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC servlet"
      end

      def mount_proc(path, &block)
        @server.mount_proc(path) { |req, res|
          begin
            code, header, response = block.call(req, res)
          rescue => e
            @log.warn "failed to handle RPC request", path: path, error: e.to_s
            @log.warn_backtrace e.backtrace

            code = 500
            body = {
              'message '=> 'Internal Server Error',
              'error' => "#{e}",
              'backtrace'=> e.backtrace,
            }
          end

          code = 200 if code.nil?
          header = {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'} if header.nil?
          body = if response.nil?
                   '{"ok":true}'
                 else
                   response.body['ok'] = code == 200
                   response.body.to_json
                 end

          res.status = code
          header.each_pair { |k, v|
            res[k] = v
          }
          res.body = body
        }
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC handler"
      end

      def start
        @log.debug "listening RPC http server on http://#{@bind}:#{@port}/"
        @thread = Thread.new {
          @server.start
        }
      end

      def shutdown
        if @server
          @server.shutdown
          @server = nil
        end
        if @thread
          @thread.join
          @thread = nil
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

def run_counter_server(counter_conf)
      @counter = Fluent::Counter::Server.new(
        counter_conf.scope,
        {host: counter_conf.bind, port: counter_conf.port, log: $log, path: counter_conf.backup_path}
      )
      @counter.start
    end

    def stop_counter_server
      @counter.stop
    end

    def install_supervisor_signal_handlers
      return if Fluent.windows?

      trap :HUP do
        $log.debug "fluentd supervisor process get SIGHUP"
        supervisor_sighup_handler
      end

      trap :USR1 do
        $log.debug "fluentd supervisor process get SIGUSR1"
        supervisor_sigusr1_handler
      end

      trap :USR2 do
        $log.debug 'fluentd supervisor process got SIGUSR2'
        supervisor_sigusr2_handler
      end
    end

    if Fluent.windows?
      # Override some methods of ServerEngine::MultiSpawnWorker
      # Since Fluentd's Supervisor doesn't use ServerEngine's HUP, USR1 and USR2
      # handlers (see install_supervisor_signal_handlers), they should be
      # disabled also on Windows, just send commands to workers instead.
      def restart(graceful)
        @monitors.each do |m|
          m.send_command(graceful ? "GRACEFUL_RESTART\n" : "IMMEDIATE_RESTART\n")
        end
      end

      def reload
        @monitors.each do |m|
          m.send_command("RELOAD\n")
        end
      end
    end

    def install_windows_event_handler
      return unless Fluent.windows?

      @pid_signame = "fluentd_#{$$}"
      @signame = config[:signame]

      Thread.new do
        ipc = Win32::Ipc.new(nil)
        events = [
          Win32::Event.new("#{@pid_signame}_STOP_EVENT_THREAD"),
          Win32::Event.new("#{@pid_signame}"),
          Win32::Event.new("#{@pid_signame}_HUP"),
          Win32::Event.new("#{@pid_signame}_USR1"),
          Win32::Event.new("#{@pid_signame}_USR2"),
        ]
        if @signame
          signame_events = [
            Win32::Event.new("#{@signame}"),
            Win32::Event.new("#{@signame}_HUP"),
            Win32::Event.new("#{@signame}_USR1"),
            Win32::Event.new("#{@signame}_USR2"),
          ]
          events.concat(signame_events)
        end
        begin
          loop do
            idx = ipc.wait_any(events, Windows::Synchronize::INFINITE)
            if idx > 0 && idx <= events.length
              $log.debug("Got Win32 event \"#{events[idx - 1].name}\"")
            else
              $log.warn("Unexpected reutrn value of Win32::Ipc#wait_any: #{idx}")
            end
            case idx
            when 2, 6
              stop(true)
            when 3, 7
              supervisor_sighup_handler
            when 4, 8
              supervisor_sigusr1_handler
            when 5, 9
              supervisor_sigusr2_handler

class SupervisorTest < ::Test::Unit::TestCase
  class DummyServer
    include Fluent::ServerModule
    attr_accessor :rpc_endpoint, :enable_get_dump
    def config
      {}
    end
  end

  TMP_DIR = File.expand_path(File.dirname(__FILE__) + "/tmp/supervisor#{ENV['TEST_ENV_NUMBER']}")
  TMP_ROOT_DIR = File.join(TMP_DIR, 'root')

  def setup
    FileUtils.rm_rf(TMP_DIR)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(TMP_DIR)
  end

  def write_config(path, data)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path))
    File.open(path, "w") {|f| f.write data }
  end


  def test_system_config
    opts = Fluent::Supervisor.default_options
    sv = Fluent::Supervisor.new(opts)
    conf_data = <<-EOC
<system>
  rpc_endpoint 127.0.0.1:24445
  suppress_repeated_stacktrace true
  suppress_config_dump true
  without_source true
  enable_get_dump true
  process_name "process_name"
  log_level info
  root_dir #{TMP_ROOT_DIR}
  <log>
    format json
    time_format %Y
  </log>
  <counter_server>
    bind 127.0.0.1
    port 24321
    scope server1
    backup_path /tmp/backup
  </counter_server>
  <counter_client>
    host 127.0.0.1
    port 24321
    timeout 2
  </counter_client>
</system>
    EOC
    conf = Fluent::Config.parse(conf_data, "(test)", "(test_dir)", true)
    sys_conf = sv.__send__(:build_system_config, conf)

    assert_equal '127.0.0.1:24445', sys_conf.rpc_endpoint
    assert_equal true, sys_conf.suppress_repeated_stacktrace
    assert_equal true, sys_conf.suppress_config_dump
    assert_equal true, sys_conf.without_source
    assert_equal true, sys_conf.enable_get_dump
    assert_equal "process_name", sys_conf.process_name
    assert_equal 2, sys_conf.log_level
    assert_equal TMP_ROOT_DIR, sys_conf.root_dir
    assert_equal :json, sys_conf.log.format
    assert_equal '%Y', sys_conf.log.time_format
    counter_server = sys_conf.counter_server
    assert_equal '127.0.0.1', counter_server.bind
    assert_equal 24321, counter_server.port
    assert_equal 'server1', counter_server.scope
    assert_equal '/tmp/backup', counter_server.backup_path
    counter_client = sys_conf.counter_client
    assert_equal '127.0.0.1', counter_client.host
    assert_equal 24321, counter_client.port
    assert_equal 2, counter_client.timeout
  end

  def test_main_process_signal_handlers
    omit "Windows cannot handle signals" if Fluent.windows?
